evidence: Built a criterion-by-observable map across all 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual). Each distinct product promise is failed by exactly one criterion: edited mark/literal earlier version/stale edit only in functional edits_and_stale_edit (judge.toml:162-179); transcript 'edited' mark only there (A.4) while search_and_transcript Part B grades heading/threading/author/hold mark/held versions (judge.toml:253-258) and transcript sent time plus same-time ordering only in sent_once_in_order Part B (judge.toml:227-229); deleted-parent placeholder only in deleted_and_expired_messages; timer shortening/off/partner-only only in timer_changes, the exact 7-day boundary only in deleted_and_expired Part B; hold scope/undeletable/spoofed 'On hold' text/release only in hold_scope_and_release; Escape, Enter/Shift+Enter, delete confirmation, highlight, transcript phone width and in-place refusal reason only in polish; persistence explicitly 'grades only durability: a feature that did not work before the restart is graded in its own criterion' (judge.toml:278); visual prompt forbids grading behaviour (visual/prompt.md:10-16). Walls vs client scope are separate promises (walls-and-retention.md:61 'The same goes for clients') graded with different actors (Dev in wall_every_route vs Gwen in signin_and_client_scope/search_and_transcript). No pair demands incompatible products: refusal forms (plain not-available for wall/scope reads vs any refusal for timer/hold/wall-lift replays), placeholder-in-place-of-quote (deleted_and_expired A.1) vs quote-on-replies (nested_replies), confirm-on-delete (delete_confirm) vs 'delete with the app control' (app_context.md:26 says confirm), and Escape-closes vs live-updates-keep-open-reply are all simultaneously satisfiable; the golden is one product meeting all. Residual overlaps are dependencies, not double grading of a separate promise: (1) re-observed positive controls (mention reaching a list in signin_and_client_scope A, wall_mentions_and_links A, edits_and_stale_edit B; link preview/opening in wall_mentions_and_links A and message_links) are required by check 30 and REVIEW_POLICY 'Reuse an observed fact, not another row's pass flag'; (2) polish link_highlight's 'brought into view' overlaps functional search_and_transcript A 'clicking that result opens M-11 at that message', but highlighting cannot be observed without arrival, and the brief ties them ('takes you to it in its thread and highlights it', conversations.md:17); (3) wrong-password refusal appears in the template render gate (template app_renders) and signin_and_client_scope A, but a gate failure already zeroes reward (score.py:41,48), so no double credit. These are recorded as P3-level observations, not defects. Source-level row; no runtime measurement is required to decide it.
